title: touchmark hub.yml
description: Settings of an engineering-assets hub: its id, the sync branch, commit and pull request settings, delivery limits, providers and pack metadata. Format v1.

version.description: Format version. Only 1 exists; when absent, 1 is assumed with a warning.

id.description: Short slug naming this hub, used in the sync branch name and in pull request markers. The template's placeholder "change-me" fails `touchmark check`.

branch.description: Sync branch in every target. Default: touchmark/<id>.

branch_aliases.description: Former sync branch names. Open pull requests on them are still recognised as this hub's own.

previous_fingerprints.description: Former fingerprints of this hub (host/numeric-repository-id), after the hub moved.

opt_in_file.description: Path of the opt-in file in targets. Default: .engineering-assets.yml.

commit.description: Commit settings. The commit author is always the provider's writer account.

message.description: Commit message. Default: "chore: sync engineering assets". Must not start with Draft: or WIP:, which turns a GitLab merge request into a draft.

author.description: Ignored with a warning: commits are always authored by the writer account.

pr.description: Pull request settings. After creation, the title, draft state and labels belong to people.

title.description: Title of new pull requests. Default: "chore: sync engineering assets". Must not start with Draft: or WIP:, which makes a GitLab or Gitea pull request a draft: set draft instead.

labels.description: Labels of new pull requests. Default: [engineering-assets]; [] for none.

draft.description: Open new pull requests as drafts. Default: false.

intro_file.description: Hub file whose text opens every pull request body.

link_hub.description: Whether the body links to the hub. auto leaves the links out when the hub is private and the target public. Default: auto.

max_new_prs_per_run.description: New pull requests per run; the rest are deferred to the next run. Default: 100.

max_close_fraction.description: If a run would close more than max(5, this fraction of the hub's open pull requests), it closes none. Default: 0.1.

memory.description: Memory of pull requests closed without merging.

auto_close_cooldown.description: How long content closed by a bot waits before it is proposed again, in days or hours. Default: 30d.

write_isolation.description: Where the write key lives. platform: in the hub's CI platform, checked by a probe; external: issued by an external vault over OIDC; none: risk accepted, needs a reason. Default: platform.

reason.description: Why the write key cannot be isolated. Required with write_isolation: none.

private_targets_in_public_hub.description: What a public hub does with non-public targets: skip them, or deliver and let their names reach public CI logs. Default: skip.

providers.description: Platforms this hub delivers to. Targets refer to them by id.

sensitive_paths.description: Patterns added to the built-in list of paths highlighted in pull requests.

packs.description: Optional metadata of packs, by pack name.

writer.description: Single-provider shorthand: the writer account, as the platform names it (on GitHub the App's bot, <slug>[bot]). Without platform, the provider's type and URL come from the CI environment, or locally from the hub's origin remote. Not allowed with providers.

sign.description: Single-provider shorthand: commit signing. Not allowed with providers.

platform.description: Single-provider shorthand: the provider type, which is also its id. Not allowed with providers.

base_url.description: Single-provider shorthand: the provider URL, for self-managed instances. Needs platform; not allowed with providers.

requires.description: Packs that must come before this one. They are added to every target that gets this pack.

formerly.description: Former names of this pack. Their history counts as this pack's own.

sign.description: auto: sign where it costs nothing and where target rules require it; always: sign every commit. Default: auto.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the repository root, with '/' separators.

pattern.description: Path or glob relative to the repository root; ** matches any number of directories.

id.description: Name targets.yml uses for this provider, and the <ID> of its TOUCHMARK_<ID>_* variables.

url.description: Web URL of the instance. Default for github: https://github.com; for gitlab: https://gitlab.com. Required for gitea and forgejo. A target targets.yml names by web URL belongs to the provider whose url it lies under.

api_url.description: API URL, when it cannot be derived from url.

ca_file.description: Hub file with extra CA certificates for this instance.

writer.description: The account that writes to targets, as the platform names it: on GitHub the App's bot, <slug>[bot]; on GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo the username of the service account or bot user.

known_authors.description: Former writer accounts whose pull requests still count as this hub's own.

automation_accounts.description: Accounts whose closing of a pull request is automatic, not a team's decision.

limits.description: Overrides of the platform's rate defaults; 0 keeps the default.

writes_per_minute.description: Writes in any minute (HTTP writes and pushes).

min_interval.description: Least time between two writes, in milliseconds or seconds, e.g. 250ms or 1s.
